verdict.rationale:
Meilisearch documents typo tolerance as an out-of-the-box default that can be tuned per index (minWordSizeForTypos, disabling typo tolerance on specific attributes, adjusting the typo ranking rule position), and a runtime probe confirms a misspelled query ('serverles') returned the correct document with zero configuration. Community feedback corroborates ease of setup and relevance, though one comment notes stricter default matching rules unrelated to typo handling.
missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence specifically testing the tunable typo rules (e.g. per-attribute disabling) rather than just the default behavior.
